## TD Cowen Raises Price Targets Across CrowdStrike, Palo Alto Networks, and Zscaler Citing AI Security Demand

A coordinated lift across the three cybersecurity leaders reinforces the AI security demand thesis and may compress relative-value spreads within the group; a PM should assess whether the AI security narrative is driving durable revenue upside or primarily multiple expansion at elevated starting valuations.

- TD Cowen lifted price targets on CRWD (to $235), ZS (to $200), and PANW in a coordinated action; PANW's new target is not disclosed in available headlines.
- The upgrades span all three major pure-play cybersecurity platforms simultaneously, signaling sector-wide conviction.
- AI-driven security demand is explicitly cited as the rationale, linking cybersecurity spend to the broader AI infrastructure buildout.
- Coordinated sector-wide PT increases from a single bank are a stronger signal than single-name upgrades.
